cohort: 755 patients who underwent hysterectomy for gynecological or obstetric reasons at Shalamar Hospital Lahore between January 2019 and December 2021
finding: Abdominal hysterectomy accounted for 94% of the procedures, and the overall mortality rate was 1.8%, with post-operative morbidity occurring in 29.4% of patients.
followup_time: The average hospital stay was 3-5 days (2-3 days for vaginal hysterectomy and 4-5 days for abdominal hysterectomy).
